detail.longDescription: I am using WSL2 to connect to a remote machine via SSH. I am running a Docker image on that remote machine with bind mounts that I want to hot-reload from host to container or vice versa, but neither is working. The file changes are not received in either direction. I've tried passing the following environment variables to my image as recommended in this issue , but that did not solve the problem. WATCHPACK_POLLING=true CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true My attempted docker run invocation looks like docker run -it --rm -e WATCHPACK_POLLING=true -e CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true ...
